_definition: Config unica del proyecto bingo (antes meta.json + kingdom_availability.json + kingdom_range_tiers.json).
_note: meta = alcance/orden/techos; availability = reglas por reino; range_tiers = rangos e/m/l/n de objetivos Combined.

meta._source: smo.wiki kingdom lists + Power Moon page
meta._boss_only_note: Cloud sin Power Moons en catalogo; Ruined: base (#1+#2) → WP Roulette Tower (#3+#4) tras el dragón. Defeat Bowser in Cloud Kingdom / Defeat Ruined Dragon en story_order.
meta._excluded_from_list: Postgame (créditos/Peach/Moon Rock/cups) + todas las lunas de Cloud (Ruined parcial: solo Roulette Tower #3+#4). Secret Path fuera de run: snow#33, seaside#49, bowser#43.

scope_excluded.postgame: Créditos (complete the game), Peach, Moon Rock, Regular/Master Cup, Cap #12+, Lost #22+, Mushroom, Dark Side, turista Mushroom#40 + sand#68 Round-the-World (sí in-scope: metro/cascade/luncheon/moon tourist); Secret Path snow#33 / seaside#49 / bowser#43.
scope_excluded.boss_only_kingdoms: Cloud y Ruined: sin Power Moons; solo Defeat Bowser in Cloud Kingdom y Defeat Ruined Dragon.

meta.scope_note: Alcance lunas: base + mid_story + revisit + world_peace. Cloud/Ruined excluidos de catálogos de lunas. Ruined: scope_moons [3,4] hasta fase 2.
meta._tier_note: Techos sand/wooded/seaside/moon. Puentes solo en reinos frontera (Sand/Lake e+m; Lost m+l; Seaside/Luncheon l+n). Interior: Cap/Cascade e; Wooded m; Metro/Snow l; Bowser/Moon n.

availability._source: smo.wiki prerequisites + criterio bingo del proyecto
availability._rule: Grandes con 2 multilunas (Sand/Wooded/Metro/Luncheon): base → mid_story (tras 1ª multi) → world_peace (tras 2ª), sin revisit. Resto con historia: base → world_peace. Pequeños: Cap solo revisit; Cascade base→WP→revisit; Lost base→revisit. Cloud/Ruined: sin lunas; solo bosses.

_tiers.base: Al llegar / antes de la 1ª multiluna (o reinos con una sola fase previa a WP).
_tiers.mid_story: Tras la 1ª multiluna en reinos con 2 (Sand/Wooded/Metro/Luncheon): el mapa cambia; aún no está la paz del reino.
_tiers.world_peace: Tras recoger todas las story moons y multilunas del reino (paz local), antes de créditos.
_tiers.postgame: Fuera de alcance: créditos (complete the game), Peach, Moon Rock, Regular/Master Cup, Cap 12+, Lost 22+, Mushroom, Dark Side, etc.

_postgame_objectives: Peach moons / Talk to the Toad at Peach's Castle
Moons with prerequisite Complete the game
Tourist moons (cadena del turista; fuera por ahora)

_boss_only_kingdoms.cloud: Defeat Bowser in Cloud Kingdom (sin Power Moons en catalogo)

patterns.revisit_only: Solo revisita (1ª visita sin lunas jugables): Cap
patterns.story: Historia 1 multi: base → world_peace, sin revisit
patterns.boss_only: Sin lunas en el proyecto; solo objetivo de boss
patterns.story_mid: Historia 2 multilunas: base → mid_story → world_peace, sin revisit (Sand/Wooded/Metro/Luncheon)

cap.notes: 1ª visita solo Topper. Lunas 1-11 en revisita. 12+ = postgame.

cascade.notes: Excepción: base → WP → revisit. Base #1-4; WP tras la multiluna; revisit #20/#24.

sand.notes: 2 multilunas. mid_story tras Showdown on the Inverted Pyramid; WP tras The Hole in the Desert.

lake.notes: 1 multiluna. WP tras Broodals Over the Lake.

wooded.notes: 2 multilunas. mid_story tras Flower Thieves of Sky Garden; WP tras Defend the Secret Flower Field.
mid_story_markers: path to the secret flower field

cloud.notes: Ignorado para lunas. Solo objetivo: Defeat Bowser in Cloud Kingdom.

lost.notes: Sin historia/multiluna. Base en 1ª visita; única revisit #13. 22+ = postgame.

metro.notes: 2 multilunas. mid_story tras New Donk City's Pest Problem (noche/músicos); WP tras A Traditional Festival.

snow.notes: 1 multiluna. WP tras The Bound Bowl Grand Prix.

seaside.notes: 1 multiluna. WP tras The Glass Is Half Full.

luncheon.notes: 2 multilunas. mid_story tras Big Pot on the Volcano; WP tras Cookatiel Showdown.

ruined.notes: 4 lunas in-scope. base: #1 multi (dragón) + #2 cofre; world_peace: #3/#4 Roulette Tower tras derrotar al dragón. 6 unidades multi×3.
final_story_markers: battle with the lord of lightning

bowser.notes: WP tras Showdown at Bowser's Castle.

moon.notes: Sin story moons locales en alcance; lunas pre-créditos = base.

range_tiers._source: Lockout All Kingdoms + techos sand/wooded/seaside/moon (puentes frontera Rush)

_zone_map.n: full — Luncheon, Bowser, Moon (+ Ruined boss)
